title: Korea 7 Day Itinerary: Seoul, Gyeongju & Busan
summary: Plan a first week in Korea with time for Seoul, historic Gyeongju, and coastal Busan. Follow the route and learn when to book the KTX.

slides.title: Seoul, Gyeongju, Busan
slides.voice: One week in Korea? Do Seoul, Gyeongju, then Busan.

slides.title: Start In Seoul
slides.sub: Three city days, then one day trip
slides.voice: Spend three days in Seoul, then take one day trip on day four.

slides.title: Take The KTX South
slides.sub: Book ahead for weekends and holidays
slides.voice: Book your KTX ahead, especially on weekends and holidays.

slides.title: Stay In Gyeongju
slides.voice: Stay overnight in Gyeongju; visit Donggung Palace and Wolji Pond after dark.

slides.title: Finish In Busan
slides.voice: In Busan, visit Haedong Yonggungsa in the morning, then Haeundae Beach at midday.
